reviews.review_title: A Charming Start with Room to Grow
reviews.review_description:
I just finished the first ten levels of Tiny Tandem. It’s a fun little game where you guide two characters through increasingly complex puzzles. Nothing too difficult, but it does require some coordination.

It reminded me a lot of guiding Quill around in Moss—if you’ve played that. (In my case, often with the same results, thankfully these little characters politely reappear after I accidentally send them off a cliff.)

So far, most of the levels involve guiding one character at a time through the path. I’m hoping future levels make more use of the two-character mechanic, where one character has to activate something or reach a certain point to let the other pass. I’d enjoy a bit more of a puzzle challenge rather than relying mostly on hand-eye coordination.

The mixed reality implementation was fun. My dog was sitting nearby, and I kept noticing him looking where I was looking, clearly wondering what had my attention while seeing none of the tiny people wandering around my room.

Overall, it’s a cute little game, and I’m looking forward to seeing where the developers take it.

reviews.review_title: Two Brains Are Better Than One!
reviews.review_description:
If you remember the classic Lemmings, you'll feel right at home with Tiny Tandem. Instead of guiding a crowd, you control two adorable characters navigate increasingly clever levels.

The levels are well designed, gradually introducing new mechanics that keep things fresh without becoming frustrating and although only 10 levels this is early access and I know the dev will continue to progress with it.

It needs audio, so perhaps music or the ability for the two character to talk to help each other or shout out when they fall off a level, some ambiant sounds will help make this game.

reviews.review_title: Lots of fun and makes you think.
reviews.review_description: I was lucky enough to win a copy of Tiny Tandem. It’s SO CUTE! I haven’t finished all the levels yet, but it gets harder as you progress. You have to find ways to get the characters to the end dot, working with them together, each controlled by one of your controllers. The graphics are so clear and sharp - it looks amazing with the tracks floating in your real world. One of the best I’ve seen. Looking forward to the developer adding new levels and seeing how they improve this puzzle game. Currently on sale so I say do it!

In this short but cute game, you control two characters and face more and more obstacles. The game currently contains 10 levels, each with different challenges, from puzzle-platforming to spinning, sliding, and moving obstacles.
Sometimes I cursed when I fell just before the finish line and wished for a checkpoint, but that's the whole point: challenge yourself!
More music would be welcome, as the current tracks play in short loops, so they start to become repetitive.
The game can be finished in about 20 minutes.
Fun fact: I found out that even though I'm right-handed, I have better accuracy and reflexes with my left hand. 🤣

TinyTandem is a super cute MR game where two adorable companions, Albo and Alba, team up to overcome clever puzzles and help each other through challenging levels. The visuals are sleek and charming, while the puzzles strike a perfect balance between fun and brain-teasing.
As an early access title, TinyTandem shows serious potential—with the studio actively expanding the game. I’d love to see levels where you control both characters simultaneously, engaging both sides of your brain! This creative and well-executed title is an absolute delight for fans of cooperative and puzzle games. Get ready to guide those two minions to victory! 🎮✨

*Early Access Review*

What a cute little, accessible puzzle game for all ages.

Very cute, bright, simple and easy to play.

You control two characters, one on each controller.. and have to get them from start to finish, by navigating along narrow pathways and through spinning and sliding gates… sometimes needing to activate a switch with one character to help the other get to the end.

There’s 10 levels so far in this early access, and it helps give a taster of what’s to come from the dev on this game… with more devious level design to make it more difficult for you to finish.

Looking forward to more levels for this game, as it’s a nice sit back and chill with the easy controls and gameplay.
